Done. I've implemented all three functions:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js: Returns n bounded to [min, max] using early returns.
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js: Converts byte counts to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place.
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js: Converts to lowercase, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes).

All three are exported and follow the project's code style.
